reply_text: @Nadia Fennimore, Gideon's July 1 update in #strategic-pod landed on **280 seats**. His first post said 300, but he corrected it at 09:19 that morning. He said the 300 came from a combined staging tab that included sandbox logins from the May rollout, and that 280 is the active count on the production roster. Ruth acknowledged the 280 figure at 09:21.
